name: quotewerks-mcp
description: Typed quote tools for QuoteWerks Web that use the real column names, preview typed writes before sending them, and add margin, win-rate and pipeline answers from a local mirror.

quotewerks_api_key.title: QuoteWerks Web API key
quotewerks_api_key.description: QuoteWerks Web API key, sent as the X-API-Key header. Create it in QuoteWerks Web under Setup > Options > Zapier and API (the API requires a user with MasterRights). Tick Allow write access only if the agent should create or change documents.

quotewerks_base_url.title: QuoteWerks Web API base URL
quotewerks_base_url.description: Overrides the API base URL. Leave blank for the default https://qwwapi.quotewerks.com.

quotewerks_user_agent.title: User-Agent header
quotewerks_user_agent.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends to QuoteWerks Web. Leave blank to use the CLI's built-in User-Agent.

quotewerks_mcp_read_only.title: Read-only MCP server
quotewerks_mcp_read_only.description: Set to exactly 1 (no other value) for a read-only MCP server: it drops sync, workflow archive, export, reports run, agent ask, agent report-draft, learnings forget and learnings reject, and refuses --confirm on docs create, items add, items reprice and requote, which can still preview. Local-only tools such as mirror and teach stay. The raw tables insert, update and delete tools are never offered over MCP. Leave blank for the full tool set.

quotewerks_mcp_http_token.title: MCP HTTP transport bearer token
quotewerks_mcp_http_token.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (a remote or hosted deployment); callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transport that Claude Desktop uses.

printing_press_client_profile.title: Client profile
printing_press_client_profile.description: Not used by this connector: QuoteWerks Web has no tenant-gated client profiles, so a value here limits nothing. Leave blank. To limit what an agent can do, give it a key without Allow write access.
